name: Talked to while irritated, Boop answers as irritated, not grumpy
case: Boop is irritated, its patience fraying, when the person asks how it's going. It answers with a face that fits: irritated or annoyed, upset, tickled or saying nothing, not the full grumpy anger; and the question alone doesn't make it grumpy.
why: PERSONALITY: talked to, Boop always answers with a face; characters/boop/steering/mood/irritated.md: its faces lean irritated, more than annoyed and short of grumpy, and it leaves for grumpy only when a turn fails or pokes go on
